title: Horizontal homotopies on mixed bar totals
statement: Let A be a preadditive category. For bicomplexes K,L with horizontal shape down Nat and vertical shape up Int whose coproduct totals exist, every horizontal chain homotopy between bicomplex maps f,g induces a cochain homotopy between their induced maps on the coproduct totals [def-sc-preorder-bar-total].

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: On the summand of horizontal degree p and vertical degree q, use the horizontal homotopy component into horizontal degree p+1, followed by its diagonal inclusion. It lowers total degree q-p by one. Its horizontal boundary is the supplied homotopy equation. Its two vertical terms cancel because the total signs in adjacent columns are opposite. Coproduct extensionality proves the homotopy equation, including the zero horizontal boundary at p=0.
